Interface InteractionMessageUtility

All Known Implementing Classes:
InteractionMessageTransmitters
public interface InteractionMessageUtility
MessagesUtility is an interface for an implementation of a utility for accessing the message information (source block, message type, destination block, etc.) of a block interaction. These block interactions are typically performed as signal transmissions or operation calls between blocks via full or proxy ports. These interactions occur during model execution forming an interaction sequence, which can be displayed in the form of a SysML sequence diagram. Use of a message utility can enable the generation of the sequence diagram during model execution.

The interface's operations are invoked by the SysMLFullPort during performance of full port transmissions, i.e. during the transmit() operation. The implementation of the MessagesUtiliy should be created in an override of the createMessagessUtility() operation by initializing the messagesUtility variable, e.g. 

       messagesUtility = new MyMessagesUtility(int arg);
where the constructor is for a class that implements the MessagesUtility interface. The referenced class below from the SysMLinJava tools package is an example implementation of this interface for transmitting interaction sequence message information to sequence diagram display applications.

  • Method Details

    • perform

      void perform(Instant time, StateBehaviorContext context, SysMLSignal messageSignal, SysMLPort peerPort, Logger logger)
      Performs the actual transmission of an interaction message (in the form a a SysMLSignal between the specified context (part or port) and the specified peer port to a sequence diagram display. The perform() operation is invoked by the SysMLPort's transmit() operation, immediately before transmitting the SysMLSignal-based message to the peer port thereby enabling real-time display of the interaction in the sequence diagram.
      Parameters:
      time - time of the interaction (message transmission)
      context - SysMLPart or SysMLPort in whose context this port resides, i.e. in which it is a port
      messageSignal - signal which contains the message
      peerPort - peer full port to which the message is transmitted
      logger - this full port's logger to be used for logging as needed

    • perform

      void perform(Instant time, StateBehaviorContext context, String message, SysMLProxyPort proxyPort, Logger logger)
      /** Performs the actual transmission of an interaction message (in the form a a String between the specified context and the specified peer proxy port to a sequence diagram display. The perform() operation is invoked by the class that invokes/calls the SysMLProxyPort operation, immediately before invoking the operation with the name specified by a text-based message in the peer proxy port thereby enabling real-time display of the interaction in the sequence diagram.
      Parameters:
      time - time of the interaction (operation call)
      context - SysMLPart or SysMLPort in whose context the proxy port call is invoked
      message - textual representation of the operation call (name, arguments, etc.)
      proxyPort - proxy port called.
      logger - this proxy port's logger to be used for logging as needed.

    • perform

      void perform(Instant time, SysMLProxyPort proxyPort, String message, StateBehaviorContext part, Logger logger)
      /** Performs the actual transmission of an interaction message (in the form a a String between the specified proxy port and the specified context part called to a sequence diagram display. The perform() operation is invoked by the SysMLProxyPort that invokes/calls the context part operation, immediately before invoking the operation with the name specified by a text-based message thereby enabling real-time display of the interaction in the sequence diagram.
      Parameters:
      time - time of the interaction (operation call)
      proxyPort - SysMLProxyPort calling the behavior context (part).
      message - textual representation of the operation call (name, arguments, etc.)
      part - context part called.
      logger - this proxy port's logger to be used for logging as needed.
